sources.label: Koios address_assets for Indigo stableswap and CDP validator payment credentials

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29. Indigo's public analytics endpoint returned 194 open iUSD CDPs: 1,293,801.377091 iUSD of debt on the native ADA branch (the API's empty collateral_asset denotes ADA) and 4,836.874073 iUSD on the NIGHT branch. Koios asset_info reported total iUSD supply of 1,396,821.282064. Indexed CDP debt therefore covers 1,298,638.251164 iUSD, represented as 92.62% ADA and 0.35% NIGHT after rounding; the 98,183.030900 iUSD residual is 7.03%. The API responses do not expose one shared historical ledger point for CDP debt and supply, and the residual may include USDCx/USDM peg-stability or CDP paths not represented in the index, so it remains explicitly unresolved rather than normalized away.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Indigo analytics iUSD CDP index and Koios iUSD supply fetched 2026-08-29; indexed minted debt attributed by collateral branch, with residual retained
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 98,183.030900 iUSD difference between policy supply and indexed CDP debt is not attributed by a shared snapshot. Indigo mint transactions and validator balances show USDCx/USDM collateral paths, but no current public endpoint reconciles those balances to individual iUSD CDPs or a peg-stability module.
